rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for benevolently intrusive, parent-like control or for something that practises paternalism.

example.english: The company's paternalistic management is always saying it is for your own good and trying to control everything.
example.traditional: 公司嗰套家長式管理，成日話為你好，乜都要管。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 go2 tou3 gaa1 zoeng2 sik1 gun2 lei5 seng4 jat6 waa6 wai6 nei5 hou2 mat1 dou1 jiu3 gun2

rows.traditional: 當 A 係細路咁管
rows.jyutping: dong1 A hai6 sai3 lou6 gam3 gun2
rows.note: Use this colloquial construction when you want to spell out the controlling behavior, treating subordinates as if they were children.

example.english: The boss is so paternalistic that they have to interfere in everything.
example.traditional: 個老闆成日當我哋係細路咁管，乜都要親自插手。
example.jyutping: go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 dong3 ngo5 dei6 hai6 sai3 lou6 gam3 gun2 mat1 dou1 jiu3 can1 zi6 caap3 sau2
